entities.summary: Buenaventura Malayo Famadico is a Filipino bishop of the Catholic Church who served as the fourth bishop of the Diocese of San Pablo from 2013 to 2023 and was previously the Bishop of Gumaca and Auxiliary bishop of Archdiocese of Lipa.
